title: Malicious code in nuxzofficial (npm)
description: The nuxzofficial package on npm contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. This compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be rotated immediately from a separate, secure device. Removal of the package alone may not fully eliminate the malicious presence, as the attacker may have established persistent control over the system.
